scope: Documented capabilities and applicable conditional guidance; no production execution, entitlement, anatomy quality, local bridge or release acceptance is established by these sources.

sources.title: Automation Test Framework
sources.supported_claim: Automation distinguishes API/unit, system/feature, stress and screenshot checks.
sources.lesson: Use separate evidence for rules, engine rendering and packaged behavior; retain results and test identities.
sources.limits: The document does not show Wonder Chess tests executed or a local automation/report-server adapter qualified.

sources.title: Data Validation
sources.supported_claim: Command-line Data Validation defaults to C++ rules; Python validators require explicit registration with the validator subsystem.
sources.lesson: Require a callback witness, applicable nonempty contract, passing fixture and failing fixture.
sources.limits: Successful validator invocation cannot establish visual quality or every runtime dependency.

sources.title: FBX Skeletal Mesh Pipeline
sources.supported_claim: The skeletal pipeline supports mesh, animation and morph interchange; automatic texture/material handling is restricted and exporter compatibility matters.
sources.lesson: Inventory imported maps, UVs, hierarchy and behavior; deliver editable Unreal controls/material recipes separately.
sources.limits: FBX export passage does not establish preservation of Control Rig, full shader graphs, UV pixel correspondence or native motion.

sources.title: IK Rig Editor
sources.supported_claim: IK Rig requires an existing skeletal mesh and configures goals, solvers and chains; incompatible bone names or hierarchies can prevent reuse.
sources.lesson: Configure semantic anatomy-specific rigs and inspect contacts, not assumed universal skeletons.
sources.limits: The feature is not proof of generated anatomy, skin quality or a compatible automation bridge.

sources.title: Multi-Image to 3D API
sources.version_label_observed: Published options include meshy-7.1; latest is documented as meshy-7.1 on retrieval
sources.supported_claim: The endpoint accepts one to four images; its current first image is primary/front, with published PBR and multi-view texturing options.
sources.lesson: Keep Wonder Chess's stricter accepted four-slot contract and pin actual model/options in each candidate.
sources.limits: Provider input tolerance does not override owner four-view policy or prove geometrically consistent views, entitlement, job permission or output quality.

sources.title: Rigging API
sources.supported_claim: Programmatic rigging is documented for clearly defined standard textured humanoid/bipedal assets, with non-humanoids listed as unsuitable.
sources.lesson: Do not submit quadrupeds or unusual Wonder Chess anatomy to a humanoid API because a website rig feature exists.
sources.limits: No API request, current credit charge, account allowance or actual rig was executed during research.

sources.title: Rigging — Webapp Guide
sources.supported_claim: Website guide advertises humanoid and quadruped rigging, and identifies limits for complex custom skeletons.
sources.lesson: Web and API capabilities are separate; require actual pose/deformation evidence and qualified Unreal fallback.
sources.limits: General marketing/help capability does not prove a given creature fits supported anatomy or that its failed web rig succeeded. Provider DCC suggestions do not override the owner Meshy-to-Unreal route.

sources.title: Asset Retention
sources.supported_claim: Ordinary API-generated models are documented with a maximum three-day retention; Enterprise is separately described.
sources.lesson: Preserve original output bytes, sanitized receipts and hashes locally rather than depend on provider links.
sources.limits: This audit does not verify the owner's Enterprise entitlement or a specific task's current availability.

sources.title: Introduction to Python Scripting
sources.supported_claim: Krita exposes native application and document operations through Python APIs.
sources.lesson: Preserve editable source and explicit transform/export recipes in the owner-selected reference preparation route.
sources.limits: The page does not qualify headless export, the exact installed app version or current blocked UI prompts.

sources.title: Creating data-driven graphics in Photoshop
sources.version_label_observed: Live Photoshop Help page; no installed version inferred
sources.supported_claim: Photoshop documents text/pixel/visibility variables, dataset import, preview and derived export.
sources.lesson: Use reviewed template variants for repeated visual collateral when it is useful, while deriving gameplay facts from canonical data.
sources.limits: Creative Cloud access does not establish product entitlement or working automation; this is an optional proposal and does not replace Krita.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guidelines
sources.supported_claim: The guidelines cover text, contrast, redundant visual/audio cues, input, navigation, focus, timing and motion among other player barriers.
sources.lesson: Integrate specific accessibility checks into real shop, deployment, combat interpretation and results journeys.
sources.limits: Guidance is not a Wonder Chess certification or evidence from disabled players; compliance is not claimed.

sources.title: Review Process — Steamworks
sources.supported_claim: Steam requires store and build review; advertised features must exist in the submitted build and it must launch on advertised supported operating systems.
sources.lesson: Bind accurate claims/gameplay captures to a near-final exact build if Steam is selected.
sources.limits: Steam is not an adopted Wonder Chess distribution commitment; a report preview, store review or successful launch does not establish enjoyment or full M7 acceptance.
